stem.en: A trolley is pushed along a level corridor at a constant speed. Later, a box is lifted slowly straight up by a crane. Which of them gains gravitational potential energy?

text.en: Only the box, because only its height increases.
Only the trolley, because it is pushed the whole time.
Both, because a force does work on each of them.
Neither, because both move at a steady speed.

explanation.en: U = mgh changes only when the height h changes. The trolley stays at the same height, so its potential energy stays the same. The box rises, so its potential energy grows. A steady speed does not matter here: it tells you the kinetic energy does not change.

hints.en: Which quantity in U = mgh can change in these two cases?
Does the trolley's height change as it moves along a level corridor?
